tools.name: send_delay_notifications
tools.description: Emails every consignee on a shipment to tell them about a delay, including the new estimated delivery date and the reason. Also posts the delay notice to the customer webhook if one is configured.

params.name: new_eta
params.description: New estimated delivery date in YYYY-MM-DD format

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, only report who would be notified without sending

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "localhost")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "25"))
SENDER = "notifications@freightops.example.com"
API = os.environ.get("SHIPMENT_API", "https://api.freightops.example.com")


def _get_shipment(sid):
    r = requests.get(f"{API}/shipments/{sid}", timeout=10)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()


def _build(to, sid, eta, why, ref):
    m = EmailMessage()
    m["From"] = SENDER
    m["To"] = to
    m["Subject"] = f"Delivery delay for shipment {sid}"
    m.set_content(
        f"Your shipment {sid} (ref {ref}) is delayed.\n"
        f"New estimated delivery: {eta}\n"
        f"Reason: {why}\n"
    )
    return m


@tool
def send_delay_notifications(shipment_id: str, new_eta: str, reason: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> str:
    """Notify consignees of a shipment delay by email and webhook."""
    s = _get_shipment(shipment_id)
    to = s.get("consignee_emails", [])
    ref = s.get("reference", "")
    hook = s.get("webhook_url")
    if not to:
        return "No consignee emails on file."
    if dry_run:
        return f"Would notify {len(to)} recipients: {', '.join(to)}"
    n = 0
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as srv:
        for a in to:
            srv.send_message(_build(a, shipment_id, new_eta, reason, ref))
            n += 1
    hk = "no webhook"
    if hook:
        r = requests.post(
            hook,
            json={"shipment_id": shipment_id, "eta": new_eta, "reason": reason},
            timeout=10,
        )
        hk = f"webhook status {r.status_code}"
    return f"Sent {n} emails; {hk}"

tools.name: submit_customs_manifest
tools.description: Uploads a shipment's customs manifest to the customs broker's API for clearance filing. Returns the broker's filing reference and status.

params.name: items
params.description: List of goods with description, hs_code, quantity, and value

tools.code:
import os

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

BROKER_URL = os.environ.get("BROKER_URL", "https://broker.example.com/v2/filings")
BROKER_KEY = os.environ.get("BROKER_API_KEY", "")


@tool
def submit_customs_manifest(shipment_id: str, port_of_entry: str, items: list) -> dict:
    """Submit a customs manifest to the broker."""
    payload = {
        "shipment_id": shipment_id,
        "port_of_entry": port_of_entry,
        "line_items": items,
        "total_value": sum(i.get("value", 0) * i.get("quantity", 1) for i in items),
    }
    r = requests.post(
        BROKER_URL,
        json=payload,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {BROKER_KEY}"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    result = {"status_code": r.status_code, "submitted_items": len(items)}
    if r.ok:
        body = r.json()
        result["filing_ref"] = body.get("filing_ref")
        result["status"] = body.get("status")
    else:
        result["error"] = r.text[:200]
    return result

tools.name: pay_freight_invoice
tools.description: Pays a carrier's freight invoice by charging the company's payment account for the invoice amount.

params.name: carrier_account_id
params.description: Connected payment account ID of the carrier

tools.code:
import os

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]


@tool
def pay_freight_invoice(invoice_id: str, amount_cents: int, carrier_account_id: str) -> str:
    """Pay a carrier freight invoice."""
    t = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=carrier_account_id,
        transfer_group=invoice_id,
        metadata={"invoice_id": invoice_id},
        idempotency_key=f"freight-{invoice_id}",
    )
    return f"Paid invoice {invoice_id}: transfer {t.id} for {amount_cents} cents"
